title: Galaktoboureko Pie with Yogurt
description: A classic Greek dessert, Galaktoboureko is a semolina custard pie wrapped in flaky phyllo pastry, served with a dollop of yogurt.
instructions: Unroll the phyllo dough and cut into 4 equal pieces.
Brush each piece with melted butter.
In a bowl, mix together semolina flour, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the galaktoboureko pie filling to the bowl and mix well.
Place a piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush with butter.
Spoon some of the semolina mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo dough and filling.
Place the triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a dollop of greek yogurt.
